card.name: Endings of drug names; 'cases' after some
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug generic name such as dyclonine, carbidopa, flumazenil or articaine. It also fires on 'cases' right after 'Some' or 'several'.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: Final piece of a generic drug name, completing the name (-ine, -opa, -il, -aine).

modes.label: Some/several cases
modes.description: The word 'cases' following 'Some' or 'several' when reporting events.
